g.text: Annual education spending per student (log scale)
Typical rural KP student: Rs 7,000 a year; top 10% spend Rs 25,000+
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file. Sample: students (ed_total > 0), rural Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, N =
4,912; 3 outside Rs 100 to Rs 1,000,000 excluded. Weighted by hhweight.
